paragraphs.en: I clung to the cross-trees, my nails aching as I tried not to look down at Hands, who lay motionless on the sand beneath. The water seemed still and green, a stark contrast to the chaos above. My mind raced with fear of falling into that same fate.
paragraphs.zh: 我紧紧抓住横木，指甲疼痛不已，强忍着不去看下方一动不动躺在沙地上的Hands。水面显得平静而碧绿，与上方的混乱形成了鲜明对比。我的脑海中充满了坠入同样命运的恐惧。

paragraphs.en: The dirk pinned to my shoulder burned like hot iron, but it was the thought of plunging into the water beside Hands' body that truly terrified me. I gripped the cross-trees tightly, shutting my eyes to block out the danger.
paragraphs.zh: 别克钉在我的肩上仿佛烙铁般灼烧，但想到要跳入Hands身旁的水中，那种恐惧才真正让我心惊胆战。我紧紧抓住横木，闭上眼睛试图避开这危险。

paragraphs.en: Gradually, my panic subsided, and I regained control. My first impulse was to remove the dirk, but either it was too firmly stuck or my nerves failed me, and I hesitated. Strangely, this hesitation worked in my favor; the knife had nearly missed me altogether, holding only by a thin thread of skin that the violent shudder tore away.
paragraphs.zh: 渐渐地，我的恐慌消退了，我也重新恢复了镇定。我首先的冲动是拔出匕首，但要么匕首插得太过牢固，要么是我的手在颤抖中失去了力气，我犹豫了起来。奇怪的是，这种犹豫反而对我有利；那把刀几乎完全避开了我，只是被一层薄薄的皮肤挂着，而剧烈的颤抖最终将这层皮肤扯断了。

paragraphs.en: With renewed strength, I broke free from the mast, tearing through my coat and shirt. I quickly made my way down to the deck via the starboard shrouds, unwilling to risk the overhanging port shrouds where Israel had just fallen.
paragraphs.zh: 恢复了力气，我从桅杆上挣脱开来，衣衫破烂，衬衫也被撕裂。我迅速通过右舷的缆索下到甲板上，不愿冒险经过刚刚以色列坠落的左舷缆索。

paragraphs.en: I went below to tend my wound, which still pained and bled freely but was not deep or dangerous. Then I considered the ship as mine now and decided to remove its last passenger—the dead O'Brien.
paragraphs.zh: 我下去处理伤口，虽然仍然疼痛并持续流血，但并不深也不危险。随后，我想到这艘船现在归我所有，并决定除掉最后一名乘客——已故的奥布赖恩。

paragraphs.en: O'Brien had fallen against the bulwarks, lying lifeless like a grotesque puppet. Despite his size, he looked nothing like a living person. I easily lifted him by the waist, as if he were a sack of bran, and tossed him overboard.
paragraphs.zh: 奥布赖恩倒在了船舷上，如同一个畸形的木偶般毫无生气。尽管他身材魁梧，却完全不像个活人。我轻而易举地将他提起腰间，仿佛提着一袋燕麦，然后将他抛入了水中。

paragraphs.en: He sank with a splash; his red cap floated to the surface. Soon, both O'Brien and Israel lay side by side on the water, their bodies moving gently.
paragraphs.zh: 他扑通一声沉入水中，红色的帽子浮上了水面。不久之后，奥布莱恩和以色列两人同时浮出水面，身体轻轻起伏。

paragraphs.en: Now alone on the ship, the tide had just turned. The sun was setting, casting shadows across the anchorage. A gentle evening breeze blew, rustling the sails and cordage softly in the cool air.
paragraphs.zh: 现在，他独自一人在船上，潮水刚刚涨起。夕阳西下，洒下金色的余晖，将锚地染上了一层淡淡的阴影。轻柔的晚风拂过，轻轻地吹动着帆布和绳索，在凉爽的空气中发出轻微的沙沙声。

paragraphs.en: I noticed danger to the ship. Quickly, I stowed the jibs, but the main-sail posed more difficulty. As the schooner tipped, the boom swung outboard, with part of the sail submerged.
paragraphs.zh: 我察觉到对船只的危险。迅速地，我把前帆收了起来，但主帆却更加棘手。随着帆船倾斜，帆桁向外摆动，部分帆布也被浸湿了。

paragraphs.en: This made it even riskier, yet the strain was too heavy for me to handle. Finally, I used a knife to cut the halyards. The peak dropped instantly, and a large piece of canvas floated on the water.
paragraphs.zh: 这使得情况更加危险，但我已经难以承受这种紧张。最终，我用刀割断了吊索。帆顶瞬间落下，一块大大的帆布漂浮在水面上。

paragraphs.en: Despite my efforts, I could not move the downhaul. Thus, all I could do was leave the HISPANIOLA to its fate.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管我使出了浑身解数，还是无法拉动下吊索。于是，我只好任由“希帕尼奥拉”号的命运自行发展。

paragraphs.en: By then, the entire anchorage was in shadow. The last rays of sunlight filtered through the trees, casting bright spots on the wreck's floral debris. It grew chilly as the tide rapidly receded and the schooner settled further on her side.
paragraphs.zh: 到那时，整个锚地都笼罩在阴影中。最后一抹阳光透过树梢洒下，照亮了沉船残骸上的花朵碎片。随着潮水迅速退去，帆船倾斜得更加厉害，天气也渐渐变冷。

paragraphs.en: I climbed forward and looked over. The water was shallow enough, so I held the cut hawser for safety before dropping into it. The water barely reached my waist, and the sand was firm beneath me.
paragraphs.zh: 我向前爬去，俯身一看。水并不深，所以我抓牢了那根断开的拖索以确保安全，然后跳了下去。水刚没过我的腰际，脚下沙地坚实稳固。

paragraphs.en: Wading ashore with great spirits, I left the HISPANIOLA on her side, with her main-sail trailing in the bay. As the sun set fully, a low breeze whispered among the pine trees.
paragraphs.zh: 精神抖擞地涉水上岸，我离开了停在岸边的HISPANIOLA号，她的主帆垂挂在海湾中。夕阳完全落山时，轻柔的微风在松树间低语。

paragraphs.en: At last, I was off the sea, not empty-handed. The schooner was now free from buccaneers and ready for our men to board and sail again. My mind turned to the stockade where I planned to boast of my achievements.
paragraphs.zh: 终于，我离开了那片海域，并非两手空空。那艘帆船已经摆脱了海盗的威胁，随时可以供我们的同伴登船起航。我的思绪转向了木栅寨，在那里，我打算炫耀一番自己的功绩。

paragraphs.en: Even if Captain Smollett might criticize me a bit for my absence, recapturing the HISPANIOLA would be a strong defense.
paragraphs.zh: 即使斯莫莱特船长可能会对我缺席有些微批评，重新夺回“伊斯帕尼奥拉”号也将是一个强有力的辩护。

paragraphs.en: As I made my way homeward towards Captain Kidd's anchorage, I remembered that the easternmost river flowed from the two-peaked hill on my left. To avoid the stream while it was still small, I turned in that direction. The woods were relatively open, and following the lower spurs, I soon rounded the corner of the hill.
paragraphs.zh: 当我向基德船长的停泊地回家时，想起最东边的那条河是从我左侧的那个双峰小山流出的。为了避免这条溪流，我在它还很小的时候转向了那个方向。树林相对稀疏，沿着较低的山脊前行，不久我就绕过了小山的拐角。

paragraphs.en: Shortly after, I waded through a shallow watercourse up to mid-calf.
paragraphs.zh: 不久之后，我趟过一条浅浅的溪流，水没过了膝盖。

paragraphs.en: Approaching where I had last seen Ben Gunn, I walked more cautiously, keeping an eye on all sides. As dusk fell, I noticed a faint glow against the sky, indicating that the maroon was cooking his supper by a roaring fire. However, I wondered why he was so careless, as this light might be visible to Silver's camp.
paragraphs.zh: 走近上次见到本·古恩的地方，我更加谨慎地行走，四下张望。随着暮色渐浓，我发现天边有一丝微弱的光芒，表明那名水手正围着熊熊燃烧的篝火准备晚餐。然而，我不禁疑惑他为何如此大意，因为这缕光亮或许会被西尔弗一伙瞧见。

paragraphs.en: Night deepened, and it became increasingly difficult to navigate. The hills behind me and the Spy-glass on my right grew fainter, and few stars were visible in the low-lying area where I wandered. Suddenly, a pale moonlight illuminated the summit of the Spy-glass.
paragraphs.zh: 夜色渐浓，导航变得越来越困难。身后的山丘和右侧的望远镜逐渐模糊不清，低洼地带几乎看不见星星。突然间，一缕淡月光照亮了望远镜的山顶。

paragraphs.en: Soon after, I saw something broad and silvery moving among the trees below, realizing that the moon had risen.
paragraphs.zh: 不久之后，我看见一道银白色的光芒在下方的树林间闪烁，意识到月亮已经升起来了。

paragraphs.en: With this light, I hurried over the remaining distance, sometimes walking and sometimes running, impatiently approaching the blockhouse. As I entered the grove in front of it, I slowed down, being careful not to be mistaken for an enemy by my own party.
paragraphs.zh: 拿着这束光，我急急忙忙地赶完了剩下的路程，时而步行，时而奔跑，迫不及待地靠近那座岗楼。当我走进岗楼前的树丛时，脚步放慢了一些，小心谨慎，以免被自己人误认为是敌人。

paragraphs.en: The moon climbed higher, casting its light through the open areas of the woods. Ahead, a different glow appeared among the trees—red and hot, occasionally darkening as if from smoldering embers of a bonfire.
paragraphs.zh: 月亮升得更高，月光透过树林中的空隙洒下。前方，树丛中出现了一抹不同的光芒——红而炽热，偶尔变得暗淡，仿佛是篝火余烬的微光。

paragraphs.en: I could not fathom what it might be. As I approached the clearing’s edge, the western end bathed in moonlight while the rest remained shadowy, with streaks of light. A large fire had turned to embers, casting a red glow that contrasted with the pale moonlight.
paragraphs.zh: 我不知那是什么。当我走近空地边缘时，西边被月光照亮，而其余部分则笼罩在阴影中，有几缕光线穿插其间。大火已化为灰烬，红光与苍白的月光形成了鲜明对比。

paragraphs.en: Wonder and a hint of fear filled me as I stopped. We rarely built such fires; we were instructed by the captain to be frugal with wood. I feared something might have gone wrong in my absence.
paragraphs.zh: 我停下脚步，心中充满了好奇与一丝恐惧。我们很少生这么大的火；船长曾教导我们要节约木材。我不禁担心，在我的缺席期间，可能出了什么差错。

paragraphs.en: I moved cautiously around the eastern side, staying in shadow until I reached a dark spot where I crawled towards the house corner. As I drew closer, my heart lightened hearing my friends snoring loudly and peacefully. The watch's "All's well" was reassuring as always.
paragraphs.zh: 我小心翼翼地绕到房子的东侧，一直躲在阴影中，直到来到一个黑暗的地方才爬向房屋的角落。随着距离越来越近，听到朋友们鼾声大作、酣然入梦，我的心也渐渐放松了。手表传来“一切安好”的声音，一如既往地让人感到安心。

paragraphs.en: Sure enough, they were keeping a poor watch. If Silver and his men had attacked, no one would have seen daylight. Blaming myself for leaving them with so few guards, I reached the door and stood inside where it was dark.
paragraphs.zh: 果然，他们的警戒做得相当糟糕。如果银和他的手下发起攻击，恐怕连天光都见不到。因为我派出去的守卫太少而自责不已，我走到门口，站在里面，外面一片漆黑。

paragraphs.en: Only the steady snoring and occasional faint noise disturbed the silence.
paragraphs.zh: 只有均匀的鼾声和偶尔传来的一丝轻微声响打破了寂静。

paragraphs.en: I walked steadily in, planning to lie down in my place and enjoy their surprise when they found me in the morning. My foot hit something soft—a sleeper's leg—and he groaned but did not wake. Suddenly, a sharp voice broke the darkness.
paragraphs.zh: 我稳步走进房间，打算躺到我的位置上，让他们早上发现我时大吃一惊。脚下一绊，踩到了什么东西柔软的部分——是一个熟睡者的腿，那人哼了一声却没有醒来。突然，一个尖锐的声音打破了黑暗的寂静。

paragraphs.en: The parrot, Captain Flint, squawked incessantly: "Pieces of eight! Pieces of eight!" The sound echoed like tiny mill wheels.
paragraphs.zh: 鹦鹉“弗林特船长”不停地叫喊：“八分之一实金币！八分之一实金币！”声音回荡着，如同无数小磨坊的轮子在转动。

paragraphs.en: I had no time to react; upon hearing her, the sleepers awoke and leaped up. Silver's voice boomed, "Who goes?" as he swore loudly.
paragraphs.zh: 我没有时间反应，听到她的声音，那些正在打盹的人立刻惊醒并跳了起来。银的声音震耳欲聋地响起：“是谁？”他大声咒骂着。

paragraphs.en: I tried to flee but collided with one person, then ran straight into another who grabbed me tightly. Silver ordered, "Bring a torch, Dick." One man left the log-house and soon returned with a lit brand.
paragraphs.zh: 我试图逃跑，却不慎撞上了一个人，紧接着又一头扎进了另一个人的怀抱。银色命令道：“迪克，拿个火把来。”一个男子离开了木屋，很快便手持点燃的火把返回了。
